notes: split_date is the exact 80% date quantile of the current production features_finance.csv, so the test rows equal production's.
lstm_calib_split is the 85% date quantile of the 2015 timeline's training rows; both timelines early-stop and calibrate on the same window.
Hyperparameters, features and seeds are unchanged from the production training scripts; only the first training date differs.

limitations: META, TSLA, ABBV, PYPL, SNAP, MRNA and UBER enter the 2005 timeline only after listing; about 37 instruments exist in 2008.
All 44 instruments are 2026 survivors, so pre-2015 years flatter the universe.
There is no text data before 2015: the 2005 sentiment models mostly learn more price history.
Yahoo adjustments are retrieval-time, not point-in-time.
The 2023-2024 test window has been examined many times; these comparisons are exploratory. The walk-forward study is the cleaner evidence.
Differences use a paired 20-session block bootstrap and are not corrected for multiple comparisons.
